info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-Replace Fitness Memberships Freeze-v4-spec
info.description: The Fitness Memberships Freeze Management API allows fitness centers to streamline the process of freezing memberships for their clients. This endpoint enables operators to update the status of a member's fitness membership, temporarily suspending billing while keeping their account active. Typically used by gym administrators and customer service representatives, this API facilitates better customer support, especially during times of travel or personal difficulties. By providing a seamless experience for both staff and members, the API enhances membership retention and satisfaction.

put.description: This operation allows you to temporarily freeze an existing membership, pausing any associated billing and access until it's resumed. This can be useful for members who need a break but wish to retain their membership status.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to freeze a membership. The client must provide the necessary information to specify which membership to freeze and any additional parameters required for the operation.
